patches.purpose: Engine bridge integration: (1) expose @hypit/cli build-planning pipeline (createCatalogDescriptor, evaluatePlanNeeds, describePlan*, assertPlannedRequests, assertPreflight, preflightPlan) and checkRunFile so the sidecar composes Build requests in-process instead of parsing CLI output; (2) package-loader readPackage treats permission-denied reads as package-not-found so the sandboxed runner's ancestor node_modules walks terminate instead of aborting resolution. Pure additive/defensive; upstream behavior unchanged without denials.

Studio base path: the vite server mounts under a deployment-configured HYPIT_STUDIO_BASE_PATH per-session base (asset URLs and the HMR websocket carry the prefix natively; loopback bind + allowedHosts keep the child broker-only), and the Studio plugin's /__studio API middleware strips the same prefix for prefixed API calls (plugin middlewares run before vite's base middleware). Inert unless env set.

Studio mutation bridge: allowsStudioMutation additionally accepts a deployment-configured HYPIT_STUDIO_BRIDGE_TOKEN bearer credential so the broker's server-side write-back bridge can submit authorized mutations on behalf of a session; bridge-credentialed POST /__studio/mutation requests compute the Source patches without applying (version control stays with the host changeset/apply pipeline). The localhost/same-origin rules stay untouched when the env var is unset.

Studio y-1 theme: inject the grassland design tokens (primary #533afd/#4434d4, dark surface, Space Grotesk display + Inter body, radius) as a style block in the Studio shell, so the embedded Studio matches the y-1 product surface. Cosmetic only; no routing or behavior change.

Trusted host-services entry for provider activations (K12.2): runtime-kit gains an optional RuntimeAdapterHostServices slot (installRuntimeAdapterHostServices) carried into RuntimeAdapterFactoryContext by runtime-local's adapterContext, and the six remote provider activations forward context.services.publicAssetUrl into their native factory options. Profile documents never carry host services; without an installed slot every patched path is a no-op, so vanilla behavior is unchanged.
